method: 16 held-out scenarios drawn from the per-skill evals.json files (foundations 3, login 2, auth 3, paywall 3, settings 2, permissions 3). Two conditions, each run by n=3 parallel general-purpose subagents that answer all 16 items in one pass: (1) baseline — answer from the model's own knowledge, NO file access, no skill; (2) with_skill — read the relevant skills/mobile-ux/*/SKILL.md files first, then apply. This isolates the lift the skills add over a capable model's prior knowledge.
grading: Per item, exact-match on a rubric truth = correct DECISION (yes/no / which) AND presence of the critical required element(s). An answer that reaches the right decision but omits the load-bearing element (e.g. says 'add account deletion' but not 'in-app, not deactivation') is scored incorrect. pass_rate per condition = mean over items of (correct_runs / 3).
